description: Create a new collection named 'Warren Court' in your Juris-M library. Then, find all U.S. Supreme Court cases in your library that were decided between 1953 and 1969 (inclusive) and add them to this new collection. Do not include cases from other eras or journal articles.

expected_cases: New York Times Co. v. Sullivan
Tinker v. Des Moines Independent Community School District
